narrative.overview:
Fractionalogic reads like a well-kept board document: a warm paper ground, deep teal ink for anything that carries authority, and structure drawn with hairlines rather than boxes. Every page proves the practice runs on logic, so sequences, pairings, comparisons, and data are shown as structure (ruled lists, numbered steps, bars, pairing diagrams) instead of decoration. The system is one family of sans type, one radius, one accent family, and one photographic treatment, repeated with discipline.

Density is moderate and editorial: a single 1060px column, generous section gaps, body text held to a ~70-character measure, and a left-aligned first viewport (breadcrumb, large Inter Display title, one-paragraph lede, primary action) with a proof element set beside the title on inner pages. Depth is almost entirely tonal: porcelain ground, white surfaces, Mist panels, and Teal 950 closing bands. Photography only appears re-toned through the Executive Logic tritone, never in natural colour.

The build explicitly refuses the consultancy default of identical icon-card grids and stock hero banners. There are no serif faces, no glyph icons standing in for content, and no gradients except the legibility tint over tritone photos.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Porcelain canvas with Logic Teal 950 Inter Display headlines at weight 600, opsz 32.
One radius (8px) for every rectangle; pills (999px) only for chips, tabs, and badges.
Silver hairline rules organise content (rule lists, data lists, recognition, steps).
Teal 650 is the single action colour; Signal Teal only marks hover and current state underlines.
Executive Brass is a rare prestige mark, never a UI colour.
Tritone teal photography confined to photo-cards (closing CTA bands, homepage feature cards, About's India tile).

rules.name: The Graphite-on-Mist Rule
rules.body: Text on a Logic Mist panel is Graphite or Teal 950, never Slate. Slate on Mist is 4.48:1 and fails AA.

rules.name: The Brass Ration Rule
rules.body: Executive Brass marks recognition and prestige only, at 5% of a screen or less. It is never a button, link, or body-text colour, and never text on a light ground.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Teal 650 is the only interactive colour on light grounds; hover deepens to Teal 800 and hover underlines use Signal Teal. On dark fields, actions flip to white.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every headline is Inter at opsz 32, weight 600, Teal 950. Do not introduce a second family or a serif for "editorial" moments.

rules.name: The Title-First Rule
rules.body: Inner-page sections open with the heading itself. No small label, kicker, or eyebrow sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, and buttons never carry shadows. Only menus that overlay content do.

rules.name: The Tritone Rule
rules.body: Photography is never shown in natural colour. It passes through the `#duotone-logic` SVG filter (luminance mapped to Teal 950 shadows, Teal 650 midtones, Mist highlights) inside a photo-card, with a Teal 950 gradient tint for text legibility.

dos: **Do** set every page on Warm Porcelain (#f7f5ef) and every headline in Inter at opsz 32, weight 600, Teal 950.
**Do** use the semantic roles (`--color-canvas`, `--color-action`, `--color-panel`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-rule`, `--color-prestige`) rather than raw palette values in components.
**Do** keep text on Logic Mist panels Graphite or Teal 950.
**Do** draw structure with 1px Silver hairlines: rule lists, data lists, step rules, dividers.
**Do** keep one 8px radius for rectangles and pills only for chips, tabs, and badges.
**Do** hold body copy to the 38rem measure and open inner pages with breadcrumb, title, lede, and a proof aside.
**Do** run all photography through the tritone filter inside a photo-card.
**Do** use the Field Border (#8a9699) and Error (#a3302a) tokens for every form control.
donts: **Don't** use a serif or a second type family.
**Don't** spend Executive Brass beyond recognition and prestige marks, or above 5% of a screen, or as text on a light ground.
**Don't** put Slate text on Logic Mist (4.48:1).
**Don't** place a small label, kicker, or eyebrow above a heading.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, panels, or buttons; only floating menus get the float shadow.
**Don't** build identical icon-card grids or stock photo hero banners.
